failure.stage: First declared CSV request after successful primary metadata qualification
failure.exception: RuntimeError: No redirects or alternate source targets
failure.failed_body_interpretation: Empty capture placeholder written by finally block; not a successful empty source file or proof of no observations.

review: Primary BCO-DMO dataset2528 metadata was captured successfully and retained verbatim. Metadata license is CC BY4.0 with Codispoti/Morrison/BCO-DMO attribution. License evidence does not establish CSV unit scales, native vertical support, QC, regional coverage or current identity.

Six synthetic cloud tests passed, but actual source acquisition failed. Passing synthetic gates does not make the actual capture successful. No source-cohort descriptor was produced, no native hydrography was decoded and no current depth estimate was calculated.

The client deliberately rejected the first CSV redirect under the frozen no-redirect policy. The response destination and body were not retained; this is a client-policy capture failure, not evidence that BCO-DMO has no accessible data or that its observations are absent.

This source case is closed without replay. The failed target must not be retried through a new version, redirect destination, mirror, alternate format or later cruise. The unspent operation and analysis reservation are accounting history, not authorization for a new allowance or a substitute cruise after this failure.

The original operator, workflow and tests remain frozen. TT049 was not attempted. The failed CSV body is empty only because the exception occurred before a body was read; its exact empty placeholder remains in the retained cloud artifact, not installed as observational data.

Historical bottle salinity maxima or temperature/salinity water-mass fractions would in any case be scoped hydrographic support, not automatically finite current boundaries, whole-route thickness or physical water volume. No such quantities are admitted here.

Local handling was limited to exact artifact byte/hash custody and manual metadata review. No local native-profile parsing, numerical science, tests, UI, runtime, WASM or default-query changes were performed. Canonical reference and eddy inventories are unchanged; programme remains incomplete.
